notes: TABS-style unit abilities. The engine implements each `kind`; the numbers here tune it. trigger says when the unit uses it (auto = the unit decides; passive = always on; on_hit = applied by its attacks; reactive = when it is attacked). power is a multiplier or amount depending on the kind (see description).

rows.name: None
rows.description: No special ability.

rows.name: Charge
rows.description: Sprints at a target 4..range blocks away at 2.3x speed; the impact deals power x weapon damage with heavy knockback and bowls over anyone in the way.

rows.name: Trample
rows.description: While moving, enemies under foot take power damage and are thrown aside every cooldown seconds.

rows.name: Whirlwind
rows.description: With 2+ enemies close, spins for duration seconds hitting everyone in radius for power x weapon damage every 0.25 s.

rows.name: Leap
rows.description: Leaps onto a target 3..range blocks away and lands with an area hit (power x weapon damage).

rows.name: Dodge
rows.description: When struck, power chance to sidestep radius blocks and take no damage.

rows.name: Riposte
rows.description: Like dodge, but answers with an instant counter-attack.

rows.name: Shield block
rows.description: Hits from the front lose power of their damage and most of their knockback; 3+ shield allies close by form a wall (+15%).

rows.name: Shield bash
rows.description: Slams an adjacent enemy: power knockback, small damage, stuns for duration seconds.

rows.name: Brace
rows.description: Plants the weapon against cavalry, large units and chargers: power x damage against them and charges break on the point.

rows.name: Headbutt
rows.description: A strike that stuns the target for duration seconds and deals power x damage.

rows.name: Frost arrows
rows.description: Hits slow the target to power x speed for duration seconds.

rows.name: Poison arrows
rows.description: Hits poison the target for power damage per second for duration seconds.

rows.name: Burn
rows.description: Flames keep burning: power damage per second for duration seconds.

rows.name: Shadowstep
rows.description: Vanishes and reappears behind a target 4..range away; the next strike deals power x damage. Prefers archers and casters.

rows.name: Cleave
rows.description: Each melee strike also hits other enemies in front for power x damage.

rows.name: War cry
rows.description: With 3+ enemies near, allies in radius deal power x damage and keep their footing for duration seconds.

rows.name: Inspiring song
rows.description: Plays on loop: allies in radius deal power x damage and keep their footing.

rows.name: Rally
rows.description: Commander aura: allies in radius stand firmer and deal power x damage.

rows.name: Healing light
rows.description: Heals every ally in radius by power when someone near is hurt.

rows.name: Chain lightning
rows.description: Bolts jump to up to duration more enemies within range for power x damage.

rows.name: Force push
rows.description: With 2+ enemies in front, pushes everything in a cone away with power knockback.

rows.name: Volley
rows.description: The next shot looses power arrows at once.

rows.name: Piercing bolt
rows.description: Bolts pass through up to power units.
